mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment ( payment_code, reservation_code, amount, means, payment_date, status, pg_code, refund, refund_date ) VALUES ( payment_seq.NEXTVAL, #{reservationCode}, #{amount}, #{means}, SYSDATE, 'COMPLETED', #{pgCode}, #{refund}, #{refundDate} )
mapper.select: SELECT payment_code AS paymentCode, reservation_code AS reservationCode, amount, means, payment_date AS paymentDate, status, pg_code AS pgCode, refund, refund_date AS refundDate FROM payment WHERE payment_code = #{paymentCode}
